verdict.rationale: Databricks documents connecting agents to external, managed, and custom MCP servers (docs-45, docs-50, docs-71) and using their tools/third-party SaaS integrations (docs-31, docs-43), plus a Marketplace listing MCP servers for discovery (docs-34/69). This directly matches the story of plugging in MCP servers to gain tool access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of the MCP-client integration working end-to-end (only vendor docs, no third-party validation).
